name: Bridge log -> Rayvn log
info: Converts Bridge format entries to Rayvn log format. Formats text with client and author prefix, adds WaSOS label to entries originating from WaSOS.

name: map Wasos log to Bridge log
info: Transforms Bridge entries to Rayvn format. Prefixes text with [client] author:, sets keyEvent and releasedInfo to false, adds WaSOS label for entries from wasos client.
